name: Mistwalker
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot back/cloak; Price 15,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a woman, the bottom half of which is misty and ghost-like, inked onto the back of the user.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following:

2/day: Cause their form to shift and waver for 5 minutes (as blur.)
1/day: Assume gaseous form (as gaseous form) for five minutes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, blur, gaseous form; Cost 7,500 gp.
